inadmissibleReason: The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C4-01: the validator verdict is now read from its own output line instead of the exit status of the tool call (grader implementation error)). A change to a frozen evaluated input invalidates the affected comparison (request, section 7.2), so this observation is not carried across the change. The case is run again under the repaired, re-frozen oracle. record.score is the grade under the oracle frozen before the run; scoring.diagnostic is a replay with the repaired oracle and is not an observation.
